subject: Customer advocate storyboard and outcomes ask — Velocity AI renewal/expansion
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@velocity.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: 1-slide outcomes + exec quote for renewal packet

Hi Claire —

Happy Friday — hope things are going well with your Q2 ramp. We’re putting together the renewal/expansion packet for the Velocity AI account and wanted to ask if you’d be open to two quick things that make a big difference for your AM/AE teams during renewal conversations:

1) A one-paragraph executive quote we can use on a customer one-pager (short, 1–2 sentences) mentioning the value you’ve seen (example below).
2) A short outcomes summary — 3 bullets with numbers (e.g., latency down X%, inference cost per call down Y%, adoption/active users up Z%).

We drafted a starter one-pager and a consent template to make this as easy as possible; attaching the draft and the consent doc. If it’s easier, I can put Neha on a 15-minute call to walk through and capture a quote live.

Example quote (feel free to edit): “Redwood’s serving improvements reduced inference latency by ~40% for our core model, unlocking a better user experience and enabling faster experimentation.”

If you’re open to this, would you also be comfortable with Redwood using the Velocity AI logo and the metrics in a case study and renewal materials? Happy to limit the scope by timeframe or channel as you prefer.

Thanks — really appreciate it.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

Attachments: velocity_outcomes_draft.docx, redwood_consent_template.pdf

From: Claire Zhou <claire@velocity.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Velocity AI Procurement <procurement@velocity.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 1-slide outcomes + exec quote for renewal packet

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the note and for doing the heavy lifting on a draft. We’re happy to help — this is valuable for our internal stakeholders too. A few quick items from our side:

- We can provide a short outcomes summary. I’ll confirm exact numbers with our analytics lead by EOD Tuesday (4/5).
- Exec quote: I can provide a short quote from our Head of Product (tilted toward speed improvements).
- Logo/metrics consent: Procurement wants a signed consent/usage scope (e.g., channels and timeframe). I’ve included procurement on this thread.

Please go ahead and share the one-pager and a very brief consent scope (1 paragraph) — if you can send a version with the specific fields you need filled, that will speed things up.

Appreciate the partnership — speak soon.

Best,
Claire Zhou
Customer Success Lead, Velocity AI
claire@velocity.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Velocity — consent + metrics (prep for one-pager)

Neha / Dylan — forwarding Claire’s note. Procurement will want a short signed consent and Claire will confirm the numbers next week. Can you two collaborate on:

- Neha: draft a one-paragraph consent and a pared-down one-pager (3 bullets + 1 quote field). I added a sample consent in the attachments; feel free to shorten.
- Dylan: please pull the final latency and cost numbers we had in the usage dashboard (Feb–Mar 2027) and drop them into the bullets. If you need access to Velocity’s analytics export, I’ll coordinate.

Goal: have a completed one-pager and consent ready to send to Claire by EOD 4/6 so we can get a signed doc before the renewal review. I’ll handle the ops with procurement if needed.

Thanks —
Lauren

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Claire Zhou <claire@velocity.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Velocity AI Procurement <procurement@velocity.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 4, 2027 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 1-slide outcomes + exec quote for renewal packet

(see original)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Claire Zhou <claire@velocity.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Velocity one-pager + consent (final)

Claire —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround. Attached is a one-pager (PDF) with the outcomes bullets filled from our side and a very short consent paragraph for signature. Key bullets we propose to include (pulled from Dylan’s usage extract):

• 40% reduction in median end-to-end inference latency after switching to Redwood dedicated pools (Feb–Mar 2027).
• 28% decrease in average inference cost per call through batching and KV caching optimizations (Feb–Mar 2027).
• 2.3x increase in daily active sessions for the feature using the served model since launch (Jan–Mar 2027).

Suggested exec quote (editable): “Redwood’s platform let us scale predictions with lower latency and predictable costs, which directly improved user engagement.”

Consent paragraph (short): "Velocity AI grants Redwood Inference permission to use the Velocity AI name, logo, and the outcomes bullets listed above in marketing materials and renewal case documentation for a period of 18 months. Redwood will not disclose raw customer data or PII."

Attachments included: velocity_onepager_v1.png, redwood_consent_template.pdf

If this looks good, Claire — can you please confirm and have procurement reply with a signed consent (or suggested edits)? If you’d prefer Neha to send a DocuSign link, we can do that as well.

Happy to hop on a 10-minute call if you prefer to edit the quote live.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
